svg.text: Two learned oscillators, in orthogonal subspaces of one table
Both carriers are narrowband spikes in a spectrum otherwise made of slow drift
Each carrier is a rotating 2-D coordinate system, not a phase
a bin vs its own sidebands = 0.99
Circularity = sigma2/sigma1 of [Re F(k); Im F(k)]. Subspace overlap = mean squared cosine of the principal angles. Both carriers are near-circles, so neither has a phase of its own.
